h: BBNaija's Mercedes reportedly appeals to Don Jazzy for financial help
p: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Mercedes has reportedly said she has been struggling financially since leaving the house and asked music boss Don Jazzy for help. She was the second housemate evicted from the Show Ya Self edition in August.
more: She previously said she hoped to raise money for her father's leg treatment.
Don Jazzy has not publicly responded yet.
